newsitem.title: CHINA: Friendship/Overseas Chinese to offer more B shares.
newsitem.headline: Friendship/Overseas Chinese to offer more B shares.

text.p: Shanghai Friendship & Overseas Chinese Co Ltd said on Tuesday it plans to issue up to 50 million additional B shares.
The company said in a statement it had not decided the timing and price of the issue.
It said it plans to invest 60 million yuan of the proceeds from the offer in a gift shop and 52 million yuan in a joint venture with Seiyu Ltd.
The issue has not been approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, it added.
Friendship & Overseas Chinese has currently 52.8 million B shares, or 47.02 percent of its total share capital, and 13.24 million A shares listed in Shanghai, it said.
